classification: one-shot construction treatment comparison; fake IPC-shaped data only
hypothesis: Explicitly changing a synthetic root-created IPC-shaped file from mode 0600 to mode 0644 on a Windows-backed Docker Desktop bind mount will permit the WSL non-root host account to read it, unlike allocation 02.
treatment_delta_from_02: After writing the identical 53-byte synthetic request, the container explicitly chmods it to 0644 before exit. No repository source is changed and no prompt/model data is used.

decision.pass: WSL non-root reads byte-identical payload and hash matches container/Windows host receipts.
decision.stop: Any invocation, mount, read, metadata or cleanup discrepancy; retain first result with no retry.

security_limit: Mode 0644 intentionally grants read access to all local users permitted by the mount. A read PASS only demonstrates the access-control tradeoff; it is not an acceptable production default or a secure IPC fix.
